hypotheses.title: Free Cash Flow Return on Productive Assets (fnd6_fopo - capex over assets)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Free Cash Flow (operating cash flow minus capital expenditures) is the purest measure of unencumbered cash generated by a firm to reward equity holders. In Batch 226, disciplined capital expenditure (-capex/assets) achieved Sharpe 1.15. Combining capex discipline with cash generation (fnd6_fopo - capex) and standardizing by total assets across subindustries isolates high-conviction free cash flow compounders with clean ~10% turnover and zero price-denominator bias.
confounders: Lumpy multi-year capital investment cycles where capex outlays precede multi-year cash flow windfalls
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high FCF return on assets underperforms cash-consuming firms within subindustries.

hypotheses.title: Operating Cash Flow to Total Debt Solvency Runway (fnd6_fopo over debt_st + debt_lt)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Credit distress and debt rollover risk penalize highly levered equities. Firms generating abundant operating cash flow relative to aggregate short and long term debt (fnd6_fopo / (debt_st + debt_lt)) have complete debt payoff capability, minimal interest rate sensitivity, and strong credit spreads. Applying subindustry cross-sectional z-scores isolates peer-relative solvency without market beta contamination.
confounders: Speculative junk debt rallies during aggressive central bank interest rate cuts
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if low debt coverage firms generate higher risk-adjusted returns over multi-year cycles.

hypotheses.title: Inverted Rank-Derivative Synergy (Cashflow Efficiency & Analyst Revisions)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 217, raw model16 rank derivatives produced an inverted Sharpe (-0.87) because platform rank fields are ascending (Rank 1 represents the #1 highest quality firm). Inverting the rank (-rank_derivative) aligns long exposure with top-tier consensus revisions and superior cashflow conversion. Combining operational efficiency with consensus momentum provides 100% universal instrument coverage across TOP3000 with ultra-low turnover.
confounders: Sudden market-wide liquidity drawdowns that supersede firm-level fundamental ranks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if top-ranked firms underperform lower-ranked peers within the same subindustry.
